_comments: Finance control for bc-aidp-next-golive#443 (g443.1 A: report and warn, sending unchanged; g443.2 A: won-deal orders only).
The same rule drives the shared user view 'Sales: Orders Invoiced Without Executed Agreement' on Order Headers and the order header's warning chip; a unit test pins the three together.

fields.Name: Sales: Orders Invoiced Without Executed Agreement
fields.UserQuestion: Which confirmed or invoiced orders from won deals have no contract, or a contract still waiting for its signed agreement?
fields.Description: Confirmed or invoiced orders from won deals whose deal has no contract, or whose contract has no executed agreement linked. Invoices still send; this lists the orders for finance to follow up.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: OrderHeader. Only the order a won deal names through Deal.OrderID (DealStatusType.IsWon). Invoiced is OrderHeader.Status = Confirmed or a Sent ExternalInvoice. The contract is Deal.ContractID, else a contract with CreatingEntity = MJ_BizApps_Sales: Deals and CreatingRecordID = the deal. Listed when no such contract has vwContracts.IsAwaitingDocument = 0; a contract type with RequiresExecutedDocument = 0 counts as covered. Contract columns show the newest candidate. No date filter; OrderDate and LastInvoiceSentAt are reported. Optional parameter: CompanyID.
